long_biography.plain_text:
Book graduated from New York University and built a career across private companies and investment vehicles. He chaired The Franklin Mint and mobile-security company SMobile Systems before his R.H. Book firm joined a private-equity partner to acquire Jet Support Services in 2008. The transaction placed him at the head of a specialist providing hourly maintenance-cost programmes for business aircraft.

Book served as JSSI chairman while the company broadened its aviation-support platform under executive management. A 2020 recapitalisation brought in GTCR alongside the existing leadership. He now chairs Book Capital Enterprises, a family office making direct debt and equity investments and backing private-equity and venture funds, and is co-vice chairman of Axxes Capital. His civic work includes board service for the Simon Wiesenthal Center and the American Friends of the Israel Antiquities Authority.
